description: Generates an image under strong structural control from one supplied guide image using Qwen Image and Alibaba PAI's Fun-Controlnet-Union (2512/2602). Broader control-type coverage than the InstantX Union ControlNet: canny, HED/soft-edge, depth, pose, MLSD, and scribble guides, plus its own inpainting mode. Use a prepared control image such as a depth map, Canny edge map, pose skeleton, or line-drawing guide; it is not an image-reference/edit workflow.
